items.title: Junior Presidents Cup Teams Finalized as Brady Barnum Claims Final U.S. Spot for Medinah
items.why: Barnum, a Georgia commit from Dublin, Ohio, locked the 12th and final U.S. spot as the highest-ranked unqualified player on the Rolex AJGA Rankings after his runner-up at the Junior PLAYERS. Matt Kuchar's side chases a fifth straight win Sept. 19 at Medinah, with C.T. Pan's International Team fielding a record 10 countries.

items.title: Trans-Miss Mid-Amateur Championship Tees Off Sunday at Lakewood CC With Ben Briscoe Defending
items.why: The 54-hole stroke play championship brings 78 players to Lakewood Country Club in Lakewood, Colo., Sept. 13-16 with two WAGR-ranked divisions. Briscoe returns to defend the Mid-Master title, while Ryan Terry of Brentwood, Tenn., the 2025 Tennessee Mid-Amateur Player of the Year, looks to improve on last year's runner-up finish. Read the full preview on midamgolfHQ.

items.title: Senior Porter Cup Decides Four Division Titles Today in Final Round at Niagara Falls CC
items.why: The 54-hole invitational in Lewiston, N.Y., closes Friday with Senior (55+), Super Senior (65+), Legends (70+) and Super Legends (75+) crowns on the line. Howard Clendenin defends the title he won at 209.

items.title: United States Holds Off Europe's Singles Charge to Retain PING Junior Solheim Cup 13-11 at Bernardus
items.why: Morgan Pressel's U.S. team led 9.5-2.5 after Monday's foursomes and four-ball, then survived Europe taking 8.5 of 12 singles points. Kelly Zhang's 2-up win over Carolina Perez-Tasso clinched it, a second straight American win that pushes the series lead to 9-4-1.

items.title: Trans-Miss Mid-Amateur Championship Tees Off Sunday at Lakewood CC With Ben Briscoe Defending
items.why: The 54-hole stroke play championship runs Sept. 13-16 at Lakewood Country Club in Lakewood, Colo. Ben Briscoe returns as the 2025 champion.

items.title: Crump Cup Senior Division Returns to Pine Valley Sept. 17-20 as Bob Royak Defends
items.why: Contested at Pine Valley since 1922, the Crump Cup's senior division runs concurrently with the mid-amateur flight on the 7,197-yard par 70. Bob Royak defends the title he won in 2025.

items.title: Chung Wins Ninja Invitational at Streamsong Black After Severe Weather Wipes Out Final Round
items.why: Kylie Chung, a 2030 grad from Cumming, Ga., posted 66-67 for a 13-under 133 and a four-shot win when the AJGA cancelled Monday's final round at Streamsong Black. Defending champion Clairey Lin and Sahana Chokshi shared second at 9-under.

items.title: Austin Lemieux Closes With 66 to Win Second WPGA Mid-Amateur Title at Fox Chapel
items.why: Lemieux won the 41st WPGA Mid-Amateur at 7-under in Tuesday's 36-hole, one-day stroke play event at Fox Chapel Golf Club. It's his second title in the championship, after his 2023 win at Nemacolin, from a 60-player field.

items.title: Senior Porter Cup Opens Today at Niagara Falls CC With Howard Clendenin Defending
items.why: The 54-hole invitational runs Sept. 9-11 in Lewiston, N.Y., with four age divisions: Senior 55+, Super Senior 65+, Legends 70+ and Super Legends 75+.

items.title: U.S. Wins PING Junior Solheim Cup 13-11 at Bernardus in First Shared-Venue Edition
items.why: Morgan Pressel's Americans closed out a 13-11 win in Tuesday's 12 singles matches at Bernardus Golf, after building a commanding lead through Monday's foursomes and fourballs. It's the first time the PING Junior Solheim Cup and the Solheim Cup have shared a host venue in the same week.

items.title: Trans-Miss Mid-Amateur Heads to Lakewood CC Sept. 13-16 With Ben Briscoe Defending
items.why: The 54-hole stroke play championship returns next week to Lakewood Country Club in Lakewood, CO. Briscoe won the 2025 title.

items.title: Crump Cup Senior Division Returns to Pine Valley Sept. 17-20 as Bob Royak Defends
items.why: The invite-only senior flight runs concurrently with the mid-am field at Pine Valley, contested at the club since 1922. Royak took the 2025 senior title over the 7,197-yard par-70 layout.

items.title: JP Lynch Closes With 66 to Win Junior PLAYERS at TPC Sawgrass; Charlie Woods T8
items.why: The Austin, Texas native (Class of 2028) started the final round three back and fired a 6-under 66 on the Stadium Course to finish 8-under 208, one clear of Brady Barnum. It's Lynch's first AJGA Invitational title, coming four days after he committed to Oklahoma; Charlie Woods tied for eighth at 1-under.

items.title: GB&I Wins Walker Cup 13½-12½ at Lahinch, First Victory Since 2015
items.why: Great Britain and Ireland overturned a 9.5-6.5 deficit by sweeping to a 7-3 win in Sunday's singles at Lahinch, claiming the Walker Cup for the first time since 2015 and ending a run of five straight American victories. Josh Hill sealed it by holing a birdie putt on the par-5 18th to beat Tyler Watts 1 up, after Jack Whaley routed William Jennings 8 and 7 and Stuart Grehan, Luke Poulter and Tyler Weaver all delivered points in the top four matches.

items.title: Senior Porter Cup Returns to Niagara Falls CC Sept. 9-11 With Howard Clendenin Defending
items.why: The invite-only 54-hole stroke play event tees off Wednesday at Niagara Falls CC with four age divisions (55+, 65+, 70+ and 75+). Clendenin won the 2025 title.

items.title: Three-Way Tie at 4-Under Heading Into Junior PLAYERS Final Round at TPC Sawgrass
items.why: Sam Carraher, Giuseppe Puebla and Dawson Lew are deadlocked at 140 through 36 holes on the Stadium Course, with Chase Bauer and Brady Barnum one back. Charlie Woods sits T14 at even par; No. 2-ranked Jaden Soong has fallen to T47.

items.title: USA Sweeps Sunday Foursomes to Take 9.5-6.5 Lead Into Walker Cup Singles at Lahinch
items.why: The United States won all four Sunday morning foursomes at Lahinch Golf Club to turn a one-point deficit into a three-point lead heading into the final ten singles matches. The USA needs 3.5 points from singles to retain the Walker Cup; GB&I needs 7 to win it back on home soil.

items.title: U.S. Senior Women's Amateur Lands at Portland Golf Club Sept. 26 as Dawn Woodard Defends
items.why: The 50-and-over championship runs Sept. 26 through Oct. 1 at the Oregon club. Woodard won last year at The Omni Homestead, beating Sue Wooster on the 20th hole.

items.title: Junior Solheim Cup Opens Monday at Bernardus in First Shared Venue With the Solheim Cup
items.why: Morgan Pressel's 12-player U.S. squad faces Anne van Dam's European team Sept. 7-8 at Bernardus Golf in Cromvoirt. It's the first time in the event's history that the Junior and senior Solheim Cups share a course.

items.title: Trans-Miss Mid-Amateur Heads to Lakewood CC Sept. 13-16 With Ben Briscoe Defending
items.why: The 54-hole stroke-play championship returns to the 6,894-yard, par-72 layout in Lakewood, Colo., where Ben Briscoe won in 2025. It's the next mid-am event on the calendar ahead of the Crump Cup and the U.S. Mid-Amateur at Sand Valley.

items.title: Senior Porter Cup Returns to Niagara Falls CC Sept. 9-11 as Howard Clendenin Defends
items.why: The invitation-only spinoff of the Porter Cup plays 54 holes across four age divisions (55+, 65+, 70+, 75+) above the Niagara River. Clendenin won last year at 66-72-71 for a 209 total.

items.title: Junior PLAYERS Championship Tees Off Today at TPC Sawgrass Without Two-Time Champ Miles Russell
items.why: The 20th Junior PLAYERS runs Sept. 4-6 on the Stadium Course, with defending champion Miles Russell absent for the Walker Cup at Lahinch. No. 2 Jaden Soong, Grayson Baucom, Sam Carraher and Charlie Woods headline the no-cut field.

items.title: Ivy Shepherd Completes Medalist-to-Champion Run, Beats McEvoy 5 and 4 for U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur Title
items.why: The 26-year-old from Peachtree City, Ga., shared stroke-play medalist honors at 1-over 141 as the No. 1 seed, then survived six matches to win her first USGA title in her first USGA championship. She earns a spot in the 2027 U.S. Women's Open at Inverness.

items.title: Mike Sposa Wins Four of Five Holes Early, Beats Todd White 3 and 2 in All-Spartanburg U.S. Senior Amateur Final
items.why: White birdied the opening hole, but Sposa answered by taking four of the next five to go 4 up through seven at Baltimore Country Club's East Course and never trailed again. Sposa, 57, is a Callaway equipment rep from Spartanburg, S.C.

items.title: Russell Henley Junior Championship Qualifier Goes Today at Green Island as AJGA Returns to Columbus
items.why: The 78-player Open Series event returns to Green Island Country Club in Columbus, Ga., with today's AJGA qualifier setting the final field for the 54-hole championship for boys and girls ages 12-19. Clark Browne of Birmingham, Ala., and Addison Peeples of Gainesville, Ga. return as defending champions.

items.title: McEvoy and Shepherd Set for 18-Hole Championship Match at U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur Final at Montclair
items.why: Sixth-seeded Catherine McEvoy of Riverside, Conn., who fired the championship's low round (4-under 66) in stroke play, faces top seed Ivy Shepherd in Thursday's 18-hole final at Montclair Golf Club in West Orange, N.J. The winner earns an exemption into the 2027 U.S. Women's Open at Inverness Club.

items.title: Todd White Birdies 16 and 18 to Oust Hester as All-Spartanburg Final Looms at U.S. Senior Amateur
items.why: The 2023 champion closed out Brendan Hester with birdies on Nos. 16 and 18, his third straight late-birdie finish after taking down Rick Stimmel and Brian Quackenbush, while Mike Sposa's clutch birdie at the par-3 17th ended Tony Wise's run. Both Spartanburg, S.C. men set up an all-Spartanburg 18-hole final Thursday morning at Baltimore Country Club.

items.title: The Junior PLAYERS Championship Presented by Rolex Tees Off Thursday at TPC Sawgrass' Stadium Course
items.why: The 58-player boys invitational, filled off the Rolex AJGA Rankings as of July 14 plus international invitees, runs Sept. 3-6 over THE PLAYERS Stadium Course in Ponte Vedra Beach. Registration and the practice round go Wednesday ahead of Thursday's opening round on one of the sport's most recognizable venues.

items.title: Quarterfinals and Semifinals Both Go Wednesday at U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur as Two Suspended R16 Matches Resume at 7:30
items.why: Amanda Jacobs (3 up thru 12 on Whitney French) and low-round-of-the-week Catherine McEvoy (1 up thru 15 on Sarah Willis) restart at 7:30 a.m. after a 6:09 p.m. weather suspension, joining top seed Ivy Shepherd, co-medalist Emilia Doran, Talia Campbell, Brooke Tyree, Katherine Zhu and Jensen Jalufka in the quarterfinals. Semifinals follow in the afternoon at Montclair, with Thursday's 18-hole final to come.

items.title: Wise-Sposa and White-Hester Headline 7:30 a.m. Quarterfinals as U.S. Senior Amateur Cuts to Eight at Baltimore CC
items.why: Tony Wise beat Nick Desai 4 and 2 playing the equivalent of 3 under through 16 and draws 2023 champion-slayer Mike Sposa, while Brendan Hester won two straight extra-hole matches (19 holes over Todd Burgan, then a birdie on the 20th to beat Dan Sullivan) and gets 2023 champ Todd White. Quarterfinals start at 7:30 a.m. Wednesday with semifinals in the afternoon, setting Thursday's 18-hole final.

items.title: Ninja Invitational Returns to Streamsong Black Sept. 5-7 as Clairey Lin Defends Inaugural Title
items.why: The 72-player girls invitational hosted by LPGA winner Janet Xiyu Lin runs 54 holes over Streamsong Black, with registration and a practice round Friday, Sept. 4, ahead of Saturday's opening round. Clairey Lin, who claimed her seventh AJGA title here in the 2025 inaugural at 12 under, returns as defending champion.

items.title: Two-Time Champion Julia Potter-Bobb Rallies From 2 Down With Six to Play at Montclair
items.why: Potter-Bobb (2013, 2016) birdied 13 and 14 to erase a two-hole deficit and beat Shannon Fish-Martin 1 up in the Round of 64. The U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur plays a 36-hole doubleheader today, Round of 32 in the morning and Round of 16 in the afternoon.

items.title: Medalist Trae Cassell Falls to Last Man In; Defending Champ Mike McCoy Misses Playoff at U.S. Senior Amateur
items.why: Cassell, who led stroke play by seven, bogeyed 16 and lost 2 and 1 to Nick Desai of Zambia, the last man into the bracket. McCoy needed an 8-foot par on the third playoff hole to reach match play and missed, ending his title defense. Top-ranked Bryan Hoops advanced 2 and 1 over George Kavanagh; Buzz Fly, who shot his age (71) in Round 1, won 1 up. Round of 32 begins at 7:30 a.m., Round of 16 this afternoon.

items.title: AJGA Debuts in South Dakota This Week as Junior at Red Rock Qualifier Goes Wednesday in Rapid City
items.why: The AJGA's new three-year Rapid City partnership tips off with a Wednesday qualifier at the Golf Club at Red Rock, followed by a Junior-Am and practice round Thursday and 54 holes of stroke play Sept. 4-6. The 78-player boys and girls field marks the association's first championship in the Black Hills, with the event locked in through 2028.

items.title: Catherine McEvoy Answers a 77 With the Low Round of the Championship, a 4-Under 66, to Reach Montclair Match Play
items.why: The Women's Met Amateur champion birdied four of her last five on the front nine Sunday for a 66, the best round of the week at the U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur, after opening with a 7-over 77. Only seven sub-par rounds were posted across two days; the cut fell at 14-over 154, tying the championship record, and McEvoy meets Taya Battistella at 1:10 p.m. in today's Round of 64.

items.title: Trae Cassell Runs Away With Medalist Honors by Seven at U.S. Senior Amateur; McCoy Headed to 13-for-3 Playoff
items.why: Cassell (Rancho Santa Fe, Calif.) followed a 68 with a 67 to post 5-under 135 at Baltimore Country Club's East Course, seven clear of the field. Defending champion Mike McCoy and 2025 runner-up Greg Sanders are among 13 players in a 7:30 a.m. playoff for the last three match-play spots, with the Round of 64 starting at 8:30.

items.title: Andy Metzler Fires 62 for 10-Shot Lead at Billy Horschel Atlanta Classic; Rasmussen Up Four in Girls Division
items.why: Metzler, a 2029 grad from Boise, Idaho, followed an opening 65 with an 8-under 62 to reach 17-under 127 at Planterra Club in Peachtree City, Ga., a 10-shot cushion over a three-way tie at 7-under. Macie Rasmussen (Chesapeake, Va., 2027) opened 63-69 to lead the girls by four over Grace Lee. Final round goes today.

items.title: Johnson and Shepherd, the Only Two Under Par, Share U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur Lead as Montclair Cut Day Arrives
items.why: Shannon Johnson and Ivy Shepherd were the only players to break par at Montclair Golf Club, each posting 1-under 69 on a demanding opening day. Defending champion Ina Kim-Schaad sits T14 at 3-over with the low 64 advancing to match play after today's second stroke-play round.

items.title: Andy Hydorn Beats the Field Average by Five, Opens 71 for T7 at U.S. Senior Amateur
items.why: Hydorn, 61, went out in 37 and came home in 34 for a 1-over 71 on a Baltimore Country Club East Course that played to a 76.46 first-round average. He tees off at 7:40 a.m. today alongside Michael Cairns and Len Komar with the low 64 of 156 advancing to match play.

items.title: Logan McGinn Wins by Four at AJGA Junior at Huntsville; Jodie Han Closes 68-68 for Five-Shot Girls Title
items.why: McGinn, a 2030 grad from nearby South Williamsport, Pa., closed with a 69 for 8-under 208 to beat Naples' Gabriel Boone by four at Huntsville Golf Club in Dallas, Pa. Jodie Han of Lewis Center, Ohio (2028) went 70-68-68 to finish 10-under 206 and win the girls division by five over Beijing's Yuyuan Jiang.

items.title: 132 Tee Off in U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur Opening Round at Montclair as Kim-Schaad Begins Title Defense
items.why: The first of two stroke-play rounds goes today over Montclair's No. 2 and No. 3 nines in West Orange, N.J., playing par 70, with the low 64 advancing to match play after Sunday. Two-time champion Ina Kim-Schaad opens her defense; the winner earns a spot in the 2027 U.S. Women's Open at Inverness.

items.title: McCoy Opens Defense at Baltimore CC Chasing First Back-to-Back U.S. Senior Amateur Since Campbell in 1980
items.why: All 156 players start 36 holes of stroke play today on Baltimore Country Club's East Course at Five Farms (par 70) before the low 64 move to match play Monday. No one has won consecutive U.S. Senior Amateurs since William C. Campbell in 1979-80; McCoy, already the only player to hold both a U.S. Mid-Am and U.S. Senior Am, is the man trying.

items.title: Junior Solheim Cup Pick Aubrey Hilgers Opens Billy Horschel Atlanta Classic After Fog Pushes Girls Start
items.why: Hilgers, ranked No. 22 in the Rolex AJGA Rankings, is one of five top-100 players in the 78-player field at Planterra Club in Peachtree City, Ga., where 54 holes of stroke play run through Sunday. The Surprise, Ariz. native arrives off a win at the 2026 Girls Junior PGA Championship and a T5 at the U.S. Girls' Junior, and was named to Morgan Pressel's U.S. PING Junior Solheim Cup team ahead of the Sept. 7-8 matches at Bernardus Golf in the Netherlands. Fog delayed the girls' opening tee times by 90 minutes.

items.title: U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur Opens Tomorrow at Montclair With 132 Players Chasing 64 Match-Play Spots
items.why: The 39th championship begins Saturday over Montclair Golf Club's No. 2 and No. 3 nines in West Orange, N.J., with 36 holes of stroke play across Saturday and Sunday before the low 64 advance to match play. Ina Kim-Schaad returns as the sixth player to win multiple U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur titles, and 2025 runner-up Hanley Long is back on the exemption she earned from their 23-hole final. The champion takes a spot in the 2027 U.S. Women's Open at Inverness Club.

items.title: U.S. Senior Amateur Begins Saturday at Baltimore CC With McCoy Defending on a 7,181-Yard Par 70
items.why: The 71st championship opens on the East Course at Five Farms in Lutherville, Md., which plays to a 75.1 course rating and a 141 slope. All 156 players go 36 holes of stroke play Saturday and Sunday before the low 64 move into single-elimination match play, with the 18-hole final set for Sept. 3. Mike McCoy is exempt as the defending champion and remains the first player to win both a U.S. Mid-Amateur and a U.S. Senior Amateur.

items.title: Billy Horschel Atlanta Classic Returns to Planterra Club With 20 Past AJGA Champions in the Field
items.why: The Billy Horschel Atlanta Classic presented by Zurich returns to Planterra Club in Peachtree City, Ga. for a fourth straight year, with a 78-player field of juniors 12-19 playing 54 holes of stroke play Friday through Sunday. The field includes 20 past AJGA champions, five top-100 players in the Rolex AJGA Rankings, and 28 Georgia natives. Follow @juniorgolfHQ on Instagram for player profiles and junior golf coverage.

items.title: Ina Kim-Schaad Defends at Montclair as 132-Player U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur Field Opens Saturday
items.why: The 39th U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur begins Aug. 29 at Montclair Golf Club in West Orange, N.J., with two rounds of stroke play before the low 64 advance to match play. Two-time champion Kim-Schaad returns after outlasting Hanley Long in 23 holes last year, the longest final in championship history, with the winner earning an exemption into the 2027 U.S. Women's Open.

items.title: 156 Players Set for 71st U.S. Senior Amateur at Baltimore CC, Where McCoy Chases History Again
items.why: The championship opens Saturday on Baltimore Country Club's par-70 East Course, with 36 holes of stroke play trimming the field to 64 for match play and an 18-hole final Sept. 3. Defending champion Mike McCoy, the only player in USGA history to win both a U.S. Mid-Amateur and U.S. Senior Amateur, headlines a field playing a course that has hosted a U.S. Open, PGA Championship, U.S. Amateur and Walker Cup.

items.title: Kuchar Taps Sohan Patel as Captain's Pick; Miles Russell Headlines First 11 for Junior Presidents Cup at Medinah
items.why: The U.S. Team is built around world No. 4 Miles Russell and returning teammate Ronin Banerjee, with Vanderbilt commit Sohan Patel earning Matt Kuchar's captain's pick after a U.S. Junior Amateur quarterfinal run. Zhi Li of China completes an all-first-timer International Team; the 12th U.S. spot is set for Sept. 10 before the Sept. 19 start on Medinah's Nos. 1 and 2.

items.title: Ina Kim-Schaad Defends at Montclair as 132-Player U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur Field Tees Off Saturday
items.why: The championship runs Aug. 29-Sept. 3 over Montclair Golf Club's No. 2 and No. 3 nines in West Orange, N.J., with 36 holes of stroke play cutting to a 64-player match-play bracket. Kim-Schaad returns after outlasting Hanley Long in 23 holes at Monterey Peninsula last year, the longest final in event history.

items.title: Mike McCoy Defends U.S. Senior Amateur as 156 Head to Baltimore CC East Course
items.why: The 71st U.S. Senior Amateur opens Saturday at Baltimore Country Club, the club's first USGA championship since the 1988 U.S. Women's Open, with 36 holes of stroke play preceding match play and a Sept. 3 final. McCoy, who in 2025 became the first player to win both a U.S. Mid-Amateur and a U.S. Senior Amateur, is exempt and back to defend.

items.title: Seven AJGA Champions Headline #OlympiaJr as Tumwater Valley Hosts First Round Today
items.why: The AJGA makes its debut at Tumwater Valley Golf Club in Olympia, Wash., with a 78-player field of boys and girls ages 12-19 opening the first of three tournament rounds today after Monday's qualifier. The field spans eight states and three countries and includes seven AJGA champions and four top-150 players in the Rolex AJGA Rankings, led by No. 91 Nicole Tang of Bellevue.

items.title: Bonyai Takes One-Shot Lead Into 36-Hole Finish at 39th Connecticut Mid-Amateur
items.why: Joe Bonyai of the eClub of Connecticut opened with a 2-under 68 at Mill River Country Club in Stratford, marking four birdies against two bogeys to lead Brian Kehoe by one. Play resumes at 8 a.m. today with 36 holes to settle the championship, and defending champion Thomas McCarthy sits in a three-way tie for third at even par.

items.title: Buzz Fly Wins Record Sixth Straight Tennessee Super Senior Amateur, Then Heads to Baltimore CC
items.why: The 71-year-old Fly closed with a 2-over 72 at Lookout Mountain Club to win the Midgett Family Trophy by three over Hubie Smith, becoming the first golfer to win the same Tennessee Golf Association event six years running. Fly qualified for next week's U.S. Senior Amateur at Baltimore Country Club, his seventh appearance, where he'll be the second-oldest player in the field.

items.title: Sunoco Junior Championship Qualifier Tees Off This Morning at Crumpin-Fox Ahead of 54-Hole Championship
items.why: Qualifier tee times go off Nos. 1 and 10 from 8-10 a.m. Monday at Crumpin-Fox Club in Bernardston, Mass., with practice rounds following in the afternoon. The 72-player field of boys and girls ages 12-19 plays 36 holes Tuesday and closes the 54-hole championship Wednesday morning on the 6,999-yard layout.

items.title: Collins Caps Wire-to-Wire Victory at 84th Valentine Invitational With 13-Under 203
items.why: Will Collins of Keswick Golf Club in Charlottesville completed a wire-to-wire victory at Hermitage Country Club, closing with an even-par 72 on the Sabot Course to finish at 13-under 203 and win by three shots over Winburne Hughes. Collins led from start to finish across all three rounds, posting 65-68-70 over the Sabot, Manakin, and Sabot courses. Blanton Farmer rounded out the top three at 7-under 209.

items.title: Shifflett Chases Third Straight as 69th VSGA Senior Women's Amateur Opens Today at The Omni Homestead
items.why: The 69th Senior Women's and 8th Super Senior Women's Amateur Championships run Aug. 24-28 on the Old Course in Hot Springs, Va., with a stroke-play qualifying round seeding a 16-player senior bracket and an eight-player super senior bracket. Kristin Shifflett arrives off back-to-back titles while Mimi Hoffman defends in the super senior division.

items.title: PacificLinks Korea Junior Championship Opens Monday at Monster Golf Club With AJGA Qualifier
items.why: The AJGA's International Pathway Series heads to South Korea, with Monday's qualifier shotgun at 8 a.m. and a practice round that afternoon at Monster Golf Club. First round goes off in two waves Tuesday, with the boys and girls fields cut to at least 50% after Wednesday's second round ahead of Thursday's finale.

items.title: Collins Takes One-Shot Lead Into Valentine Invitational Final Round as Hughes Charges at Hermitage
items.why: Will Collins carded a 4-under 68 on the Manakin Course to reach 11-under 133 through 36 holes, one clear of Memphis's Winburne Hughes, who posted the day's low round at 7-under 65. Blanton Farmer sits third at 8-under with Sunday's final round on the Sabot Course deciding the 84th Valentine. [Follow live scoring here](https://www.golfgenius.com/pages/12338736295793668275).

items.title: 33rd Utah Senior State Amateur Tees Off Monday at Mountain Dell With USGA Exemption on the Line
items.why: The UGA's senior championship runs Aug. 24-27 on the Lake Course at Mountain Dell Golf Club, one of only two official USGA exemption events on the association's calendar. The four-day championship arrives the same week the U.S. Senior Amateur field convenes at Baltimore Country Club.

items.title: Van Dam Names 12-Player European Team for PING Junior Solheim Cup at Bernardus
items.why: Captain Anne van Dam completed her European side with six automatic qualifiers off the PJSC ranking and six picks headlined by R&A Girls' Amateur champion Marta Munoz. The Sept. 7-8 matches at Bernardus Golf mark the first time the junior event is played on the same course as the Solheim Cup, with Morgan Pressel's U.S. team already set.

items.title: Rank Wins Fourth Canadian Mid-Amateur Title; Collins Fires Opening 65 to Lead Valentine Invitational
items.why: Garrett Rank closed with a 3-under 69 to erase Evan Nachtigall's two-shot lead and win at 18-under 270, joining Stu Hamilton as a four-time champion and trailing only seven-time winner Graham Cooke. The victory earns Rank an exemption into the U.S. Mid-Amateur at Sand Valley. Meanwhile at Hermitage Country Club, Will Collins of Charlottesville fired a 7-under 65 on the Sabot Course to grab a four-shot lead after Round 1 of the 84th Valentine Invitational, with Nicolas Brown, Blanton Farmer, and Winburne Hughes sharing second at 3-under 69. [Follow Valentine live scoring here](https://www.golfgenius.com/pages/12338736295793668275).

items.title: U.S. Senior Amateur Field of 156 Heads to Baltimore CC With McCoy Defending, Aug. 29-Sept. 3
items.why: The 71st U.S. Senior Amateur opens Aug. 29 on Baltimore Country Club's par-70 East Course, with two stroke-play rounds cutting to a 64-man match-play bracket and the final on Sept. 3. Mike McCoy returns as defending champion a year after becoming the first player in USGA history to win both the U.S. Mid-Amateur and U.S. Senior Amateur.

items.title: Ananyaa Sood Wins First AJGA Title, Lester Low Takes Boys Division at K.J. Choi Foundation Junior Championship
items.why: Ananyaa Sood of New Delhi closed with a 3-under 69 to win at 2-under 214 in just her fifth AJGA start at Fiddler's Elbow. Lester Low of Evanston, Ill. captured the boys title at 5-under 211 for his second AJGA victory, one clear of New Jersey's Rayhao Feng.

items.title: Nachtigall Takes Two-Shot Lead Into Canadian Mid-Amateur Finale as Rank Chases Fourth Title
items.why: Evan Nachtigall of Brandon, Man. eagled the first en route to a 68 and sits at 17-under through 54 holes at Brantford, two clear of three-time champion Garrett Rank, who would join Stu Hamilton and Graham Cooke as the only four-time winners. The champion earns an exemption into the U.S. Mid-Amateur at Sand Valley. Meanwhile, the 84th Valentine Invitational tees off today at Hermitage Country Club in Manakin-Sabot, Va., with defending champion John Hunter and 2007 U.S. Mid-Amateur champion Trip Kuehne headlining an 82-player mid-am field. [Follow live scoring here](https://www.golfgenius.com/pages/12338736295793668275).

items.title: Mike McCoy's Title Defense Headlines U.S. Senior Amateur at Baltimore CC, Aug. 29-Sept. 3
items.why: The 71st U.S. Senior Amateur brings a 156-player field to Baltimore Country Club's East Course for 36 holes of stroke play before the low 64 advance to match play. McCoy returns as defending champion after becoming the first player in USGA history to win both the U.S. Mid-Amateur and U.S. Senior Amateur.

items.title: Junior PLAYERS Championship Field Set for TPC Sawgrass With Soong, Jolly, Huebner Among 73 Invitees
items.why: The AJGA's flagship boys invitational returns to the PLAYERS Stadium Course Sept. 8-10 for 54 holes on the identical setup used for THE PLAYERS, island green included. The confirmed field spans 15 countries and includes Junior PGA champion Jaden Soong, Southern Junior winner Neil Jolly and Wyndham Invitational champion Jessy Huebner, with two-time defending champion Miles Russell absent from the list.

items.title: Nachtigall Leads Canadian Men's Mid-Amateur by One Over Rank Heading Into R3 at Brantford
items.why: Evan Nachtigall followed his opening 64 with a 5-under 67 to take the solo lead at 13-under 131 through 36 holes at Brantford Golf & Country Club. Three-time champion Garrett Rank (2014-16) is one back at 12-under, with Haymes Snedeker and Alex Large tied for third at 9-under. Two rounds remain in the 72-hole championship through August 21.

items.title: Valentine Invitational Tees Off Friday at Hermitage With Quackenbush Defending
items.why: The Mid-Atlantic's marquee senior invitational plays 54 holes across Hermitage Country Club's Sabot and Manakin courses outside Richmond, Aug. 21-23. Brian Quackenbush returns as the 2025 champion in a national field that fills the gap between Sunnehanna and the U.S. Senior Amateur at Baltimore CC.

items.title: Marigliano, Feng and Cui Headline KJ Choi Foundation Junior Championship at Fiddler's Elbow
items.why: The K.J. Choi Foundation Junior Championship by One Alliance runs Aug 17-20 on the River Course at Fiddler's Elbow, with 96 boys and girls ages 12-19 playing 54 holes and a 36-hole cut. The field includes 32 New Jersey natives, 13 past AJGA champions and five players inside the Rolex AJGA top 150.

items.title: Canadian Men's Mid-Amateur Continues at Brantford With Rank, Nachtigall, vonKalckreuth Sharing R1 Lead
items.why: Three-time champion Garrett Rank (2014-16), Evan Nachtigall, and Nolan vonKalckreuth share the lead at 8-under 64 after the opening round at Brantford Golf & Country Club. Round 2 continues today with the field chasing the 72-hole national title through August 21.

items.title: Sunnehanna Senior Amateur Final Round Today at Sunnehanna Country Club
items.why: The invitation-only championship for elite 55-and-over amateurs closes today at par-70 Sunnehanna Country Club in Johnstown, Pa. Tony Wise is the 2025 defending champion.

items.title: HV3 Foundation Junior Championship Opens First Round Today at Mooresville Golf Club
items.why: The third annual #HV3Jr tees off its opening round Tuesday at Mooresville Golf Club in North Carolina, with 78 boys and girls ages 12-19 playing 54 holes through Aug 20. Thirty North Carolina natives headline the Open Series field; Jack Kelley and Macie Rasmussen are the defending champions.

items.title: Canadian Men's Mid-Amateur Opens Today at Brantford as Garrett Rank Headlines 155-Player Field
items.why: The 72-hole national championship presented by BDO tees off today at Brantford Golf & Country Club in Ontario. Three-time champion Garrett Rank (2014-16), former champion Rob Couture (2011), and Derek Meinhart, who finished third in 2023, headline a field of 155 players from across Canada plus 11 Americans.

items.title: 79th VSGA Senior Amateur Championship Underway at River Bend Club in Great Falls
items.why: Virginia's senior amateur championship runs Aug 17-21 at River Bend Club, one of the longest weeks on the VSGA calendar. The event moves to River Bend after Bay Creek hosted last year.

items.title: Weather Pushes Play Chesterfield Junior Championship First Round Back Two Hours at Meadowbrook
items.why: AJGA delayed opening-round tee times two hours to 9:30 a.m. ET Monday at Meadowbrook Country Club in Richmond, Va. The 78-player Open Series field for boys and girls 12-19 now chases 54 holes through Aug 19.

items.title: 34th Illinois State Mid-Amateur Opens Today at Edgewood Valley With 36-Hole Monday Grind
items.why: The CDGA-run championship for Illinois amateurs 25 and over runs Aug 17-18 at Edgewood Valley Country Club in Burr Ridge, with the full field playing 36 holes Monday before a cut to the low 35 and ties. Lake Forest's Max Scodro won last summer.

items.title: Full 156-Player Field Set for U.S. Senior Amateur at Baltimore Country Club
items.why: The USGA released the field for the Aug 29-Sept 3 championship on Baltimore Country Club's East Course, with 11 past champions including defender Mike McCoy among 37 exempt players. A record-adjacent 2,779 entries were pared through 50 qualifying sites.

items.title: Play Chesterfield Junior Championship Qualifier Goes Off Today at Meadowbrook Ahead of 54-Hole Championship
items.why: The AJGA qualifier tees off 7:30-9:30 a.m. Sunday at Meadowbrook Country Club in Richmond, Va., with a practice round following in the afternoon. The 78-player Open Series championship for boys and girls ages 12-19 runs 54 holes Aug 17-19.

items.title: Canadian Men's Mid-Amateur Up Next on Major Schedule as Fitzsimmons Defends at Brantford
items.why: The 72-hole championship presented by BDO runs Aug 18-21 at Brantford Golf & Country Club in Ontario, open to amateurs 25 and over. Three-time winner Charles Fitzsimmons defends; the champion earns exemptions into the 2026 U.S. Mid-Amateur plus the 2027 Canadian Amateur and Mid-Amateur.

items.title: Sunnehanna Senior Amateur Tees Off Today as Tony Wise Defends at Sunnehanna Country Club
items.why: The 54-hole stroke play championship runs Aug 16-19 at Sunnehanna Country Club in Johnstown, Pa. Wise, the 2025 champion, returns to defend at the par-70, 6,716-yard invite-only event.

items.title: Angela Liang Catches Betsy Mitchell Atop Roper Honda AJGA Junior Championship Final Round
items.why: Mitchell's six-shot lead is gone. Angela Liang of Bridgewater, N.J. shot 69 Friday and the two are tied at 6-under through 12 holes of Saturday's final round at Twin Hills in Joplin, Mo. On the boys side, Porter Hart of Broken Arrow, Okla. leads at 7-under after rounds of 68-69.

items.title: Charles Fitzsimmons Defends at Canadian Men's Mid-Amateur Opening Monday at Brantford
items.why: The 72-hole championship presented by BDO runs Aug 18-21 at Brantford Golf & Country Club in Ontario, open to amateurs 25 and over. Fitzsimmons, already a three-time winner of the national title, defends; the champion earns exemptions into the 2026 U.S. Mid-Amateur plus the 2027 Canadian Amateur and Mid-Amateur.

items.title: Full Field Out for U.S. Senior Amateur at Baltimore CC With 10 Past Champions in the Draw
items.why: The USGA has posted the complete field for the Aug 29-Sep 3 championship on Baltimore Country Club's East Course (Five Farms), headlined by past champs Sean Knapp, Mike McCoy, Todd White, Jeff Wilson, Gene Elliott and Doug Hanzel. Recent North & South Super Senior winner Rick Cloninger and Sunnehanna defender Tony Wise are both in.

items.title: Betsy Mitchell Fires 8-Under 64 to Seize Six-Shot Lead at Roper Honda AJGA Junior Championship
items.why: Kansas City's Betsy Mitchell (class of 2029) opened with an 8-under 64 at Twin Hills Golf & Country Club in Joplin, Mo., six clear of Nora Shelor. On the boys side, Jack Butterbaugh and Porter Hart share the lead at 4-under 68 with the final round Friday.

items.title: Bailey and Ebert Take 10-Under Lead into Picard Cup Final Round at Canterbury
items.why: Canterbury member Andrew Bailey and John Ebert sit at 10-under 134 through best ball and alternate shot, two ahead of four teams at 8-under including 2025 Crump Cup champ Bobby Wyatt and Vince Cave. The closing best-ball round goes today at Canterbury Golf Club.

items.title: Cavaliere Falls in Round of 16 as Last Mid-Am Standing at U.S. Amateur
items.why: Christian Cavaliere was the last mid-amateur alive in the U.S. Amateur bracket at Merion but was knocked out in the Round of 16. Match play continues through the weekend toward Sunday's 36-hole final.

items.title: Sunnehanna Senior Amateur Pairings Drop Today Ahead of Aug 17-19 Championship
items.why: First- and second-round tee times for the Sunnehanna Senior Amateur post by 5 p.m. today, with the 54-hole championship running Aug. 17-19 at Sunnehanna Country Club in Johnstown, Pa. Tony Wise defends, and the field cuts to the low 70 and ties after 36 holes.

items.title: Randy Wise Junior Open Reaches Fog-Delayed Final Round at Spring Meadows
items.why: The 20th Randy Wise Junior Open presented by Genesee County wraps up today at Spring Meadows CC in Linden, Mich., with final-round tee times pushed back an hour by fog. Eight past AJGA champions are in the field of boys and girls ages 12-19.

items.title: Hagestad and Cavaliere Still Alive at U.S. Amateur as Picard Cup Opens at Canterbury
items.why: Stewart Hagestad and Christian Cavaliere remain in the U.S. Amateur bracket as match play continues at Merion. Meanwhile, the 32nd Picard Cup kicks off today at Canterbury Golf Club in Beachwood, Ohio, with 36 mid-amateur teams competing in three rounds of best ball and alternate shot. Full Picard Cup coverage on the [tournament hub here](/midamgolfhq/the-picard-cup).

items.title: Rick Stewart Wins North & South Senior Amateur at Pinehurst; Cloninger Takes Super Senior
items.why: Rick Stewart of Park Ridge, Ill., closed 70-72-71 for 3-under 213 and a one-shot win in the championship that ended Wednesday on Pinehurst No. 4. Rick Cloninger finished with back-to-back rounds in the 60s to take the Super Senior division.

items.title: Miles Russell Leads Junior Contingent Into U.S. Amateur Match Play at Merion
items.why: The 17-year-old finished stroke play at 3-under to make the Round of 64, which begins today at Merion, while World No. 1 Preston Stout missed the match-play cut.

items.title: 32nd Picard Cup Tees Off Tomorrow at Canterbury as Fiore and Joseph Defend
items.why: 36 mid-amateur teams play three rounds of best ball and alternate shot Aug 13-14 at Canterbury Golf Club in Beachwood, Ohio, with a field headlined by 2025 Crump Cup champ Bobby Wyatt.

items.title: North & South Senior Men's Amateur Crowns a Champion Today at Pinehurst
items.why: The 54-hole championship wraps its final round today across Pinehurst Nos. 4, 5 and 8, with Howard Clendenin defending his 2025 title.

items.title: Roper Honda AJGA Junior Championship Tees Off at Twin Hills in Joplin
items.why: The AJGA's national event at Twin Hills Golf and Country Club in Joplin, Mo. is underway this week, with Monday's qualifier complete, Tuesday's Junior-Am, and championship rounds to follow for the field of boys and girls ages 12-19.

items.title: U.S. Amateur Stroke Play Continues at Merion With Mid-Am Names Behr, Lowe in the Mix
items.why: The 126th U.S. Amateur at Merion Golf Club and Philadelphia Cricket Club enters its second day of stroke play, with mid-amateurs Tyler Behr and Matt Lowe among those chasing the 64 match-play spots. The cut comes after today's second round.

items.title: North & South Senior Men's Amateur Match Play in Full Swing at Pinehurst No. 4
items.why: The championship runs Aug 10-12 at Pinehurst No. 4, with match play deciding one of senior amateur golf's crown jewels.

items.title: Asterisk Talley, 17, Routs Anna Iwanaga 8&6 to Win U.S. Women's Amateur at The Honors Course
items.why: The 17-year-old from Chowchilla, Calif. claimed her second USGA title before finishing high school, falling 1 down early in the morning before winning the 36-hole final going away. Talley birdied Nos. 11-13 in the morning round and never trailed again.

items.title: Mid-Am Contingent Led by Brandon Holtz, Evan Beck Opens U.S. Amateur Stroke Play Today at Merion
items.why: The 126th U.S. Amateur begins today at Merion and Philadelphia CC with reigning U.S. Mid-Am champ Brandon Holtz, 2024 champ Evan Beck, runner-up Jeg Coughlin III, Stewart Hagestad, and Indiana Amateur winner Matt Vogt in the 312-player field chasing 64 match-play spots.

items.title: Sunnehanna Senior Amateur Tees Off Sunday as Tony Wise Defends
items.why: The 54-hole stroke-play championship runs Aug 16-19 at Sunnehanna CC in Johnstown, Pa., with 2025 champion Tony Wise back to defend.

items.title: Talley, Iwanaga Hold 3-Up Leads as Weather-Delayed U.S. Women's Amateur Semifinals Resume Sunday
items.why: Another weather suspension pushed the semis to a 7 a.m. ET Sunday finish at The Honors Course, with top-ranked junior Asterisk Talley 3 up on Lily Peng and co-medalist Anna Iwanaga 3 up on Gabriella Nicastro. The 36-hole final follows, with Golf Channel coverage from 3 p.m. ET.

items.title: 32nd Picard Cup Field Preview: Defending Champions Fiore and Joseph Return to Canterbury
items.why: 36 mid-amateur teams play three rounds of best ball and alternate shot Aug 13-14 at Canterbury GC, where Nick Fiore and Brian Joseph defend against a field headlined by 2025 Crump Cup champ Bobby Wyatt with Vince Cave.

items.title: North & South Senior Men's Amateur Tees Off Monday at Pinehurst as Howard Clendenin Defends
items.why: The 54-hole championship runs Aug 10-12 with one round each on Pinehurst Nos. 4, 5, and 8, split into Open and Super-Senior divisions, and defending champion Howard Clendenin back in the field.

items.title: Nora Qu Wins Playoff Thriller at Justin Thomas Junior Championship; Cooper Smith Takes Boys Title
items.why: Qu (Irvine, Calif.) beat defending champion Elin Wang in a three-hole playoff after both finished 11-under 202 at Harmony Landing. Cooper Smith closed with an even-par 71 to win the boys title at 8-under for his first AJGA victory, one clear of Henry Schreiber.

items.title: Lauren Greenlief Captures Second Canadian Women's Mid-Amateur After Weather Shortens Final Round
items.why: With Friday's final round washed out at Burlington G&CC, Greenlief's 36-hole lead (opening 7-under 65) stood up for her second title (2017, 2026). The win earns her a spot in the 2026 U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur at Montclair.

items.title: Mike McCoy, 63, Headlines Senior Contingent at U.S. Amateur With Record 21st Appearance at Merion
items.why: The reigning U.S. Senior Amateur champion is the oldest player in the field starting Monday and the only one who played the 2005 U.S. Am at Merion. He's joined by Haymes Snedeker, 50, fresh off low-am honors at the U.S. Senior Open, plus 2024 Senior Am champ Louis Brown and 2025 runner-up Greg Sanders.

items.title: Cooper Smith, Nora Qu Take Leads Into Final Round of Justin Thomas Junior Championship
items.why: Smith (Jasper, Ga.) sits at 8-under 134, one clear of hometown favorite Luc Kelty of Louisville heading into today's final round at Harmony Landing. Nora Qu leads the girls at 9-under, three ahead of defending champion Elin Wang.

items.title: Naumec Fires 66 to Medal at U.S. Mid-Amateur Qualifying at Renaissance Golf Club
items.why: Matthew Naumec (Boston) carded eight birdies for a 6-under 66 and medalist honors, with Robert Henley and Sam Grindle (playoff winner) also punching tickets to The Lido at Sand Valley, Sept 26-Oct 1. Venezuela's Jose Aguilar holed his drive for an albatross on the 338-yard 10th.

items.title: Fiona Connor Rallies to Win 28th Women's Ohio Senior Amateur at Fairlawn
items.why: Connor closed with a 78 to come from one back and win by three at Fairlawn Country Club. Cynthia Acker cruised to the Super Senior Division title by nine.

items.title: Justin Thomas Junior Championship Underway at JT's Home Course, Harmony Landing
items.why: The AJGA Open Series event is live this week in Goshen, Ky., with a 78-player field competing over 54 holes at Justin Thomas' home club. Elin Wang and Graham Christopher are the defending champions.

items.title: U.S. Women's Amateur Match Play Begins at The Honors Course With Ina Kim-Schaad in the Field
items.why: Match play gets underway at The Honors Course in Ooltewah, Tenn., after two days of stroke-play qualifying. Two-time U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur champion Ina Kim-Schaad is among the mid-am competitors in the 64-player bracket.

items.title: North & South Senior Men's Amateur Tees Off Monday at Pinehurst
items.why: One of the country's oldest senior amateur championships runs Aug 10-12 over Pinehurst Nos. 4, 5 and 8, with Howard Clendenin defending in a national field split into Open and Super-Senior divisions.

items.title: Junior Stars Headline 126th U.S. Women's Amateur Opening Today at The Honors Course
items.why: Stroke play begins today (Aug 4-9) in Ooltewah, Tenn., with 51 of the 156 players aged 14-17, including 2026 U.S. Girls' Junior champion Clairey Lin making her debut, Aphrodite Deng and Asterisk Talley, plus five U.S. National Junior Team members.

items.title: Bret Parker Fires 65 to Medal as U.S. Mid-Amateur Qualifying Rolls On at Lochland CC
items.why: Parker (Alpine, Utah) shot 7-under Monday to take medalist honors, with Omaha's Grant Jabenis two back. Both punched tickets to the 45th U.S. Mid-Amateur at Sand Valley's Lido course, Sept 26-Oct 1.

items.title: U.S. Senior Women's Amateur Qualifying Underway - Road to Portland Golf Club Runs Through Sept 2
items.why: Qualifying for the 64th U.S. Senior Women's Amateur opened July 30 and runs through Sept 2, with the championship set for Portland Golf Club, Sept 26-Oct 1.

items.title: Morgan Pressel's Captains' Picks Tuesday Complete U.S. PING Junior Solheim Cup Team for Bernardus Golf
items.why: Eight players led by No. 1 Asterisk Talley earned automatic spots via the Rolex AJGA Rankings, and captain Morgan Pressel announces her four picks Tuesday, Aug 4. For the first time, the Junior Solheim Cup (Sept 7-8) will be played on the same course as the Solheim Cup at Bernardus Golf in the Netherlands.

items.title: Barnes Blake Defeats Mid-Am Christian Cavaliere 7&5 in 124th Met Amateur Final at Deepdale
items.why: Cavaliere's run at one of the region's most prestigious titles ended in the final, as Baltusrol's Blake became just the third player in 102 years to win the New Jersey Amateur and Met Amateur in the same season.

items.title: U.S. Senior Amateur Field Takes Shape as Qualifying Wraps - Baltimore CC Awaits Aug 29-Sept 3
items.why: Qualifying at 50 sites concluded July 30, setting the field for the 71st U.S. Senior Amateur at Baltimore Country Club's East Course, Aug 29-Sept 3.

items.title: Jaden Soong, Aubrey Hilgers Capture Titles at 50th Junior PGA Championships at PGA Frisco
items.why: Soong survived a shaky start and a three-shot swing at the 17th to win the Boys Division, while Hilgers birdied 17 to force a playoff and beat Yujie Liu with a bunker save in sudden death for the Girls title.

items.title: Christian Cavaliere Reaches Met Amateur Final
items.why: Christian Cavaliere, who runs popular brand Tremont, has reached the final of the Met Amateur Championship. Cavaliere, a competitive mid-amateur who played the U.S. Open at LACC, looks to add one of the region's most prestigious titles to his resume.

items.title: North & South Senior Amateur Tees Off Aug 10-12 at Pinehurst
items.why: Registration opens Aug 9 ahead of the three-day championship at Pinehurst Resort, one of the marquee senior amateur events of the summer.

items.title: Jaden Soong and Aubrey Hilgers Capture 50th Junior PGA Championship Titles at PGA Frisco
items.why: Soong rallied on the back nine at Fields Ranch, taking the Boys title with a birdie at 17 as co-leaders Stone and Stanford made double. Hilgers matched Yujie Liu at 6-under 282 and won the Girls title in sudden death.

items.title: MGA Mid-Amateur Championship Semifinals Today
items.why: The MGA Mid-Amateur Championship reaches the semifinal round today, with the top mid-amateurs in the Metropolitan Golf Association region battling for a spot in the final.

items.title: Sunnehanna Senior Amateur Returns Aug 10-12 at Sunnehanna Country Club
items.why: Tony Wise defends at the invite-only stroke-play championship at Sunnehanna Country Club in Johnstown, Pa. The event brings together elite 55-and-over amateurs for 54 holes.

items.title: Four Girls Tied, Jaden Soong Leads Boys as 50th Junior PGA Championships Reach Final Round at PGA Frisco
items.why: Gia Ahlowalia, Alexandra Phung, Ava Zhang and Alexa Takai share the girls lead at 5-under while Soong leads the boys by two at 8-under heading into today's finale on Fields Ranch East, streamed live on the PGA of America's YouTube channel.

items.title: PNGA Men's Mid-Amateur Field Set for Royal Oaks as Wyatt Brook Defends Aug 18-20
items.why: Entries closed this week for the 54-hole championship in Vancouver, Wash., where 2025 champion Wyatt Brook defends against a 66-player field; the PNGA Women's Mid-Am runs concurrently.

items.title: U.S. Senior Amateur Qualifying Concludes - Field Takes Shape for Baltimore Country Club
items.why: The June 24-July 30 qualifying window across 50 sites has closed, setting the field for the championship Aug 29-Sep 3 on Baltimore Country Club's East Course.

items.title: Takai and Stone Lead 50th Junior PGA Championships Into 54-Hole Cut Day at PGA Frisco
items.why: Hawaii's Alexa Takai fired a 6-under 66 to take the girls lead at 9-under, while Kailer Stone holds a one-shot boys lead at 9-under 135. Each division cuts to the low 30 and ties after today's third round, which streams live on the PGA of America's YouTube channel.

items.title: First U.S. Mid-Amateur Qualifiers Punch Tickets to The Lido at Sand Valley
items.why: Qualifying opened July 27 and the first of 69 sites have wrapped, with early qualifiers advancing from Virginia, Illinois, Utah, Michigan, and Alaska. Sites run through September 2 ahead of the Sep 26-Oct 1 championship at The Lido at Sand Valley.

items.title: U.S. Senior Women's Amateur Qualifying Opens Today on the Road to Portland Golf Club
items.why: Qualifying for the 64th U.S. Senior Women's Amateur begins today, July 30, and runs through September 2. The championship is set for Sep 26-Oct 1 at Portland Golf Club in Portland, Ore.

items.title: Liu and Stone Lead 50th Junior PGA Championships Into Cut Day at PGA Frisco
items.why: Texas' Carolyn Liu fired an 8-under 64 on Fields Ranch West to lead the Girls Division, while Pepperdine-bound Kailer Stone leads the boys by one at 4-under. Each division cuts to the low 60 and ties after today's second round.

items.title: U.S. Women's Mid-Amateur Qualifying Wraps Today as Field Takes Shape for Montclair
items.why: The final qualifiers conclude today, closing the June 24-July 29 window and setting the field for the championship Aug 29-Sep 3 at Montclair Golf Club in West Orange, N.J.

items.title: Entries Close Friday for Sunnehanna Senior Amateur at Sunnehanna Country Club
items.why: Entries close Friday, July 31 at 6 p.m. ET for the 54-hole championship, played Aug 16-19 in Johnstown, Pa.

items.title: 50th Junior PGA Championships Tee Off Today at Fields Ranch at PGA Frisco
items.why: 156 boys and 156 girls open 72 holes of stroke play July 28-31 on Fields Ranch East & West, with Charlie Woods and four top-20 juniors in the field. New for 2026, the final two rounds stream live on the PGA of America's YouTube channel.

items.title: Entries Close Today for PNGA Men's Mid-Amateur at Royal Oaks
items.why: The entry deadline is today at noon for the Aug 18-20 championship at Royal Oaks Country Club in Vancouver, Wash., where Wyatt Brook defends in a 66-player field decided by handicap index.

items.title: U.S. Senior Amateur Qualifying Enters Final Days on Road to Baltimore Country Club
items.why: Qualifying at 50 sites wraps up July 30, finalizing the field for the 71st U.S. Senior Amateur, Aug 29-Sep 3 at Baltimore Country Club's East Course in Lutherville, Md.

items.title: Noah Maclauchlan Stuns Miles Russell 6&5 to Win 78th U.S. Junior Amateur at Saucon Valley
items.why: Maclauchlan of Moseley, Va., ranked No. 2,047 in the WAGR, upset top-ranked junior Miles Russell 6 and 5 in Saturday's 36-hole final on Saucon Valley's Old Course to claim the Tiger Woods Trophy.

items.title: 40th Maryland Mid-Amateur Tees Off Today at Maryland Golf & Country Club
items.why: The MSGA's 40th Maryland Mid-Amateur runs July 27-28 at Maryland Golf & Country Club in Bel Air, part of a late-summer stretch that also has U.S. Mid-Am qualifiers rolling toward Sand Valley.

items.title: Sunnehanna Senior Amateur Returns to Johnstown Classic Aug 10-12
items.why: Tony Wise defends at the invite-only Sunnehanna Senior Amateur, Aug 10-12 at Sunnehanna Country Club, the 1923 design that has hosted amateur golf's best for a century.

items.title: Maclauchlan Earns U.S. Open and U.S. Amateur Exemptions With Junior Am Title
items.why: On 2026-07-26: Noah Maclauchlan's U.S. Junior Amateur victory at Saucon Valley earns him exemptions into the 2027 U.S. Open at Pebble Beach and the next two U.S. Amateurs, capping a breakout week for the Virginia teenager.

items.title: Picard Cup Four-Ball Next Up on Mid-Am Calendar Aug 13-14 at Canterbury
items.why: On 2026-07-26: The Picard Cup four-ball invitational at Canterbury Golf Club in Beachwood, Ohio, is the next event on the mid-am major calendar. The two-day event brings together top mid-amateur teams from across the country.

items.title: Sunnehanna Senior Amateur Two Weeks Away as Tony Wise Prepares to Defend
items.why: On 2026-07-26: The invite-only Sunnehanna Senior Amateur is two weeks out (Aug 10-12) at Sunnehanna Country Club in Johnstown, Pa. Defending champion Tony Wise returns to the field.

items.title: Noah Maclauchlan Stuns Miles Russell 6&5 in U.S. Junior Amateur Final at Saucon Valley
items.why: On 2026-07-25: Noah Maclauchlan of Moseley, Va., ranked No. 2,047 in the WAGR, upset top-ranked junior Miles Russell 6 and 5 in the 36-hole final on Saucon Valley's Old Course to claim the 78th U.S. Junior Amateur and the Tiger Woods Trophy.

items.title: U.S. Mid-Amateur Qualifying Picks Up as Sand Valley Championship Nears
items.why: On 2026-07-25: Local qualifying for the U.S. Mid-Amateur continues at sites across the country, with the championship set for Sand Valley Golf Resort in Nekoosa, Wis., Sept. 13-18.

items.title: U.S. Senior Amateur Qualifying Rolls On Ahead of Baltimore Country Club
items.why: On 2026-07-25: Qualifying for the U.S. Senior Amateur continues across the country, with the championship set for Aug. 29-Sept. 3 at Baltimore Country Club's East Course in Lutherville, Md.

items.title: Quarterfinal Friday at U.S. Junior Amateur; Top-Ranked Miles Russell Among Final Eight
items.why: On 2026-07-24: Quarterfinals go this morning and semifinals this afternoon at the 78th U.S. Junior Amateur at Saucon Valley CC. items.title: Matt Lowe in the Hunt as Monroe Invitational Reaches Moving Day at Monroe Golf Club
items.why: On 2026-07-24: Round 3 goes today at the 85th Monroe Invitational at Monroe Golf Club in Pittsford, N.Y., with the field cut to the low 45 and ties ahead of Saturday morning's final round. Mid-am Matt Lowe, the reigning Ike MGA Stroke Play champion, is in the hunt in a field that also includes two-time Ohio Amateur champion Andrew Bailey.

items.title: U.S. Senior Amateur Qualifying Enters Its Final Week on the Road to Baltimore
items.why: On 2026-07-24: Qualifying for the U.S. Senior Amateur wraps up Thursday, July 30, with the last spots on the line at remaining sites nationwide. The championship field heads to the East Course at Baltimore Country Club in Lutherville, Md., Aug. 29-Sept. 3.

items.title: U.S. Junior Amateur Cuts to 16 Today at Saucon Valley After Woods Falls in Playoff
items.why: On 2026-07-23: Match play continues Thursday at the 78th U.S. Junior Amateur with the rounds of 32 and 16 at Saucon Valley CC, ahead of Saturday's 36-hole final. Charlie Woods' week ended Wednesday with a bogey on the first hole of the 14-for-2 playoff for the last match-play spots, which sent Eli Wessel and Hudson Kutchma into the bracket.

items.title: Mid-Ams Including Two-Time Ohio Amateur Champ Andrew Bailey Tee It Up at 85th Monroe Invitational
items.why: On 2026-07-23: The 85th Monroe Invitational continues with round 2 today at Monroe Golf Club in Pittsford, N.Y., a 72-hole test running through Saturday with a cut to the low 45 and ties after round 3. Mid-amateurs in the field include two-time Ohio Amateur champion Andrew Bailey.

items.title: U.S. Senior Women's Amateur Qualifying Opens July 30 on the Road to Portland Golf Club
items.why: On 2026-07-23: Qualifying for the 64th U.S. Senior Women's Amateur begins July 30 and runs through Sept. 2, with the championship set for Portland Golf Club in Portland, Ore., Sept. 26-Oct. 1.

items.title: Match Play Begins at U.S. Junior Amateur; Coleman Out, Woods in Playoff for Final Spots
items.why: On 2026-07-22: The round of 64 begins today at the 78th U.S. Junior Amateur at Saucon Valley CC after Miles Russell, Sohan Patel and Brayden Jones shared medalist honors at 6-under. Charlie Woods was among 14 players in a Wednesday morning playoff for the final two match-play spots, while defending champion Hamilton Coleman missed the cut at 8-over.

items.title: Lauren Cupp Wins 17th NYS Women's Mid-Amateur by Eight Shots at Pinehaven
items.why: On 2026-07-22: Lauren Cupp of Yahnundasis Golf Club posted rounds of 74-80 for a 154 total at Pinehaven Country Club in Guilderland, N.Y., winning the 17th NYS Women's Mid-Amateur by eight over Samantha Schuffenecker and Kim Kaul. The Hamilton College golf coach adds a second title in the event to her 2017 win.

items.title: U.S. Senior Amateur Qualifying Runs Through July 30 Ahead of Baltimore CC Championship
items.why: On 2026-07-22: Qualifying for the U.S. Senior Amateur continues at sites across the country through July 30, with the championship set for the East Course at Baltimore Country Club in Lutherville, Md., Aug. 29-Sept. 3.

items.title: U.S. Junior Amateur Stroke Play Day 2 at Saucon Valley — Cut to 64 Looms
items.why: Round 2 of stroke play at the 78th U.S. Junior Amateur at Saucon Valley CC today, with the field of 264 being cut to 64 for match play. Defending champion Hamilton Coleman looks to advance.

items.title: U.S. Mid-Amateur Qualifying Season Heats Up Ahead of September Championship
items.why: Local and sectional qualifying for the U.S. Mid-Amateur is underway across the country, with the championship set for September at a site to be determined. Top mid-amateurs are sharpening their games through state and regional events.

items.title: VSGA Super Senior Stroke Play Wraps Up at Lake Chesdin
items.why: The final round of the 41st VSGA Super Senior Stroke Play Championship at Lake Chesdin Golf Club concludes today.

items.title: U.S. Junior Amateur Opens Today at Saucon Valley — Stroke Play Begins on Old and Grace Courses

items.title: Society of Seniors Spring Classic (Aileron): Mallon wins Senior Division
items.why: Final results: William Mallon won the Senior Division at 6-under 210 (three straight 70s), holding off Todd Doss (3-under 213). This is the type of early-season win that usually sets up a strong run once the schedule fills up.
